estilos.prompt_suno_curto: Uplifting Ambient Electronic, 103 bpm, C Major. Smooth electronic drums, clean synth bass, ethereal pads, bright synth melody. Features high-pitched female vocal chops (ooh/aah) and subtle rhythmic male vocal chops. Modern, inspiring, tech mood.
estilos.prompt_suno_longo:
Genre: Uplifting Ambient Electronic / Modern Corporate Instrumental / Chill Tech.
BPM: 103. Key: C Major.
Mood: Clean, professional, inspiring, optimistic, calm yet forward-thinking, technological, ethereal, spacious, slightly dreamy.
Drums: Minimalist electronic, soft kick, crisp closed hi-hats, subtle filtered snare on 2 and 4.
Bass: Clean warm synth bass, sustained root notes.
Synth Pads: Wide atmospheric evolving pads with shimmer.
Synth Lead: Bright clear melody, catchy optimistic cyclic pattern.
Female Vocal Chops: Prominent high-pitched ethereal ooh/aah samples, heavy reverb, delay, pitch-shifted up, layered with pads, angelic abstract quality.
Male Vocal Chops: Very subtle low-pitched rhythmic processed sussurro/hum, filtered percussive texture in lower-mid frequencies.
Overall: Polished contemporary instrumental, blend of electronic with processed human voices, inviting forward-looking soundscape.

estilos.prompt_suno_curto: Corporate Tech Electro Pop, uplifting, 118 BPM, F Major, plucked synth arpeggio hook, warm pads, soft four-on-the-floor drums, pulsating bass, clean bright modern mix.
estilos.prompt_suno_longo:
Corporate Tech Electro Pop, uplifting and positive, 118 BPM, F Major.

Warm analog synth pad with slow attack and lush reverb creating wide atmospheric bed.
Prominent plucked/bell-like synth arpeggiator playing ascending and descending eighth-note
patterns with synced delay and reverb — this is the main melodic hook.
Soft pulsating synth bass marking chord roots in long notes or octaves.
Light electronic drums: soft four-on-the-floor kick, reverbed clap on 2 and 4,
closed hi-hats in eighth/sixteenth notes with shakers for brightness.
Occasional synth stabs and subtle electronic percussion clicks for texture.

Structure: soft intro (pad + arpeggio only), gradual drum and bass entry into main loop,
consistent energy throughout, gentle fade out at the end. No dramatic drops or breaks.

Mood: positive, motivational, intelligent, future-focused, clean, bright, professional.
Like background music for a Google/Apple tech product video or innovation documentary.

estilos.producao: reverb nos synths/pads, delay no arpeggio, sidechain pumping sutil
estilos.prompt_suno_curto: Uplifting Progressive Trance, instrumental, 132 BPM. Driving four-on-the-floor kick, bright arpeggiated synth lead, continuous pulsating bassline, airy pads, subtle sidechain pumping. High-energy, futuristic, optimistic. No vocals.
estilos.prompt_suno_longo: Uplifting Progressive Trance, Instrumental. High-energy, driving, futuristic, and optimistic. Features a powerful four-on-the-floor kick drum and dynamic electronic hi-hats. The core is a bright, resonant arpeggiated synth lead playing a repetitive, melodic pattern, underpinned by a continuous, slightly resonant synth bassline. Airy, sustained synth pads provide a wide harmonic background. Subtle sidechain compression creates a 'pumping' feel. Moderate reverb and delay on synths enhance spaciousness. No vocals. Tempo: 132 BPM. Structure: Steady build of electronic elements.

estilos.prompt_suno_curto: Anthem pop rock, energetic male tenor lead with belting and light rasp, ethereal female mezzo backing harmonies on choruses, driving hymn-like energy.
estilos.prompt_suno_longo: Anthem pop rock with an infectious hymn-like energy. Male lead vocal: tenor, range G3 to B4, strong chest voice moving into a fluid mixed register on the high notes, bright metallic cutting timbre, slightly grainy/raspy texture at peak projection, medium controlled natural vibrato, consistent belting with subtle grit. Female backing vocal: mezzo-soprano, range C4 to G5, mixed voice shifting to head voice on the highs, bright limpid timbre, smooth ethereal texture, soft delicate vibrato. The male lead dominates while the female voice complements with tight anthem-like harmonies, overlapping on the chorus sections. Powerful yet clear high notes, contagious anthemic energy — energetic male timbre combined with limpid female harmonies.
